many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # non-bg components; keep largest component of the second-most-common color? try: cells equal most common non-bg color within largest component
    order=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common() if c!=bg]
    best=None
    seen=set()
    for start in [(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]!=bg]:
        c=g[start[0]][start[1]]; st=[start]; comp=[]
        while st:
            a,b=st.pop()
            if (a,b) in seen or a<0 or b<0 or a>=len(g) or b>=len(g[0]): continue
            if g[a][b]!=c: continue
            seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
            st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
        if len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    if best:
        for a,b in best: g[a][b]=g[best[0][0]][best[0][1]]
        for (a,b) in set(i for row in g for i in row)-set(best): g[a][b]=bg
    return g
d=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(f(d)==o)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
